name: Replace at Playhead
description: Restores the 'Replace at Playhead' edit mode (drag-drop menu + ⌥⇧R Command Editor shortcut) that Apple removed from FCP's UI, and adds 'Replace and Retain Attributes' (⌥⇧⌘R) which replaces the timeline clip at the playhead while preserving its effects/color/transform attributes. Survives SpliceKit patcher updates.
author: SpliceKit
